ayahs.ar: تَبٰرَكَ الَّذِيۡ بِيَدِهِ الۡمُلۡكُؗ وَهُوَ عَلٰي كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ قَدِيۡرُۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Tabaarakal lazee biyadihil mulku wa huwa 'alaa kulli shai-in qadeer
ayahs.en: Blessed is He in whose hand is dominion, and He is over all things competent -

ayahs.ar: اِۨلَّذِيۡ خَلَقَ الۡمَوۡتَ وَالۡحَيٰوةَ لِيَبۡلُوَكُمۡ اَيُّكُمۡ اَحۡسَنُ عَمَلًاؕ وَهُوَ الۡعَزِيۡزُ الۡغَفُوۡرُۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Allazee khalaqal mawta walhayaata liyabluwakum ayyukum ahsanu 'amalaa; wa huwal 'azeezul ghafoor
ayahs.en: [He] who created death and life to test you [as to] which of you is best in deed - and He is the Exalted in Might, the Forgiving -

ayahs.ar: الَّذِيۡ خَلَقَ سَبۡعَ سَمٰوٰتٍ طِبَاقًاؕ مَا تَرٰي فِيۡ خَلۡقِ الرَّحۡمٰنِ مِنۡ تَفٰوُتٍؕ فَارۡجِعِ الۡبَصَرَۙ هَلۡ تَرٰي مِنۡ فُطُوۡرٍ
ayahs.tl: Allazee khalaqa sab'a samaawaatin tibaaqam maa taraa fee khalqir rahmaani min tafaawutin farji'il basara hal taraa min futoor
ayahs.en: [And] who created seven heavens in layers. You do not see in the creation of the Most Merciful any inconsistency. So return [your] vision [to the sky]; do you see any breaks?

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ ارۡجِعِ الۡبَصَرَ كَرَّتَيۡنِ يَنۡقَلِبۡ اِلَيۡكَ الۡبَصَرُ خَاسِئًا وَّهُوَ حَسِيۡرٌ
ayahs.tl: Summar ji'il basara karrataini yanqalib ilaikal basaru khaasi'anw wa huwa haseer
ayahs.en: Then return [your] vision twice again. [Your] vision will return to you humbled while it is fatigued.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ زَيَّنَّا السَّمَآءَ الدُّنۡيَا بِمَصَابِيۡحَ وَجَعَلۡنٰهَا رُجُوۡمًا لِّلشَّيٰطِيۡنِ وَاَعۡتَدۡنَا لَهُمۡ عَذَابَ السَّعِيۡرِ
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad zaiyannas samaaa'ad dunyaa bimasaa beeha wa ja'alnaahaa rujoomal lish shayaateeni wa a'tadnaa lahum 'azaabas sa'eer
ayahs.en: And We have certainly beautified the nearest heaven with stars and have made [from] them what is thrown at the devils and have prepared for them the punishment of the Blaze.

ayahs.ar: وَلِلَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا بِرَبِّهِمۡ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَؕ وَبِئۡسَ الۡمَصِيۡرُ
ayahs.tl: Wa lillazeena kafaroo bi rabbihim 'azaabu jahannama wa bi'sal maseer
ayahs.en: And for those who disbelieved in their Lord is the punishment of Hell, and wretched is the destination.

ayahs.ar: اِذَا٘ اُلۡقُوۡا فِيۡهَا سَمِعُوۡا لَهَا شَهِيۡقًا وَّهِيَ تَفُوۡرُۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Izaaa ulqoo feehaa sami'oo lahaa shaheeqanw wa hiya tafoor
ayahs.en: When they are thrown into it, they hear from it a [dreadful] inhaling while it boils up.

ayahs.ar: تَكَادُ تَمَيَّزُ مِنَ الۡغَيۡظِؕ كُلَّمَا٘ اُلۡقِيَ فِيۡهَا فَوۡجٌ سَاَلَهُمۡ خَزَنَتُهَا٘ اَلَمۡ يَاۡتِكُمۡ نَذِيۡرٌ
ayahs.tl: Takaadu tamayyazu minal ghaizi kullamaaa uliqya feehaa fawjun sa alahum khazanatuhaaa alam yaatikum nazeer
ayahs.en: It almost bursts with rage. Every time a company is thrown into it, its keepers ask them, "Did there not come to you a warner?"

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡا بَلٰي قَدۡ جَآءَنَا نَذِيۡرٌ ࣢ۙ فَكَذَّبۡنَا وَقُلۡنَا مَا نَزَّلَ اللّٰهُ مِنۡ شَيۡءٍۚۖ اِنۡ اَنۡتُمۡ اِلَّا فِيۡ ضَلٰلٍ كَبِيۡرٍ
ayahs.tl: Qaaloo balaa qad jaaa'anaa nazeerun fakazzabnaa wa qulnaa maa nazzalal laahu min shai in in antum illaa fee dalaalin kabeer
ayahs.en: They will say," Yes, a warner had come to us, but we denied and said, 'Allah has not sent down anything. You are not but in great error.'"

ayahs.ar: وَقَالُوۡا لَوۡ كُنَّا نَسۡمَعُ اَوۡ نَعۡقِلُ مَا كُنَّا فِيۡ٘ اَصۡحٰبِ السَّعِيۡرِ
ayahs.tl: Wa qaaloo law kunnaa nasma'u awna'qilu maa kunnaa feee as haabis sa'eer
ayahs.en: And they will say, "If only we had been listening or reasoning, we would not be among the companions of the Blaze."

ayahs.ar: فَاعۡتَرَفُوۡا بِذَنۭۡ بِهِمۡۚ فَسُحۡقًا لِّاَصۡحٰبِ السَّعِيۡرِ
ayahs.tl: Fa'tarafoo bizambihim fasuhqal li as haabis sa'eer
ayahs.en: And they will admit their sin, so [it is] alienation for the companions of the Blaze.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ يَخۡشَوۡنَ رَبَّهُمۡ بِالۡغَيۡبِ لَهُمۡ مَّغۡفِرَةٌ وَّاَجۡرٌ كَبِيۡرٌ
ayahs.tl: Innal lazeena yakhshawna rabbahum bilghaibi lahum maghfiratunw wa ajrun kabeer
ayahs.en: Indeed, those who fear their Lord unseen will have forgiveness and great reward.

ayahs.ar: وَاَسِرُّوۡا قَوۡلَكُمۡ اَوِ اجۡهَرُوۡا بِهٖؕ اِنَّهٗ عَلِيۡمٌۭ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُوۡرِ
ayahs.tl: Wa asirroo qawlakum awijharoo bihee innahoo 'aleemum bizaatis sudoor
ayahs.en: And conceal your speech or publicize it; indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.

ayahs.ar: اَلَا يَعۡلَمُ مَنۡ خَلَقَؕ وَهُوَ اللَّطِيۡفُ الۡخَبِيۡرُࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Alaa ya'lamu man khalaq wa huwal lateeful khabeer
ayahs.en: Does He who created not know, while He is the Subtle, the Acquainted?

ayahs.ar: هُوَ الَّذِيۡ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الۡاَرۡضَ ذَلُوۡلًا فَامۡشُوۡا فِيۡ مَنَاكِبِهَا وَكُلُوۡا مِنۡ رِّزۡقِهٖؕ وَاِلَيۡهِ النُّشُوۡرُ
ayahs.tl: Huwal lazee ja'ala lakumul arda zaloolan famshoo fee manaakibihaa wa kuloo mir rizqihee wa ilaihin nushoor
ayahs.en: It is He who made the earth tame for you - so walk among its slopes and eat of His provision - and to Him is the resurrection.

ayahs.ar: ءَاَمِنۡتُمۡ مَّنۡ فِي السَّمَآءِ اَنۡ يَّخۡسِفَ بِكُمُ الۡاَرۡضَ فَاِذَا هِيَ تَمُوۡرُۙ‏
ayahs.tl: 'A-amintum man fissamaaa'i aiyakhsifa bi kumul arda fa izaa hiya tamoor
ayahs.en: Do you feel secure that He who [holds authority] in the heaven would not cause the earth to swallow you and suddenly it would sway?

ayahs.ar: اَمۡ اَمِنۡتُمۡ مَّنۡ فِي السَّمَآءِ اَنۡ يُّرۡسِلَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ حَاصِبًاؕ فَسَتَعۡلَمُوۡنَ كَيۡفَ نَذِيۡرِ
ayahs.tl: Am amintum man fissamaaa'i ai yursila 'alaikum haasiban fasata'lamoona kaifa nazeer
ayahs.en: Or do you feel secure that He who [holds authority] in the heaven would not send against you a storm of stones? Then you would know how [severe] was My warning.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ كَذَّبَ الَّذِيۡنَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِهِمۡ فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ نَكِيۡرِ
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad kazzabal lazeena min qablihim fakaifa kaana nakeer
ayahs.en: And already had those before them denied, and how [terrible] was My reproach.

ayahs.ar: اَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡا اِلَي الطَّيۡرِ فَوۡقَهُمۡ صٰٓفّٰتٍ وَّيَقۡبِضۡنَؔۘؕ مَا يُمۡسِكُهُنَّ اِلَّا الرَّحۡمٰنُؕ اِنَّهٗ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍۭ بَصِيۡرٌ
ayahs.tl: Awalam yaraw ilat tairi fawqahum saaaffaatinw wa yaqbidn; maa yumsikuhunna illaar rahmaan; innahoo bikulli shai im baseer
ayahs.en: Do they not see the birds above them with wings outspread and [sometimes] folded in? None holds them [aloft] except the Most Merciful. Indeed He is, of all things, Seeing.

ayahs.ar: اَمَّنۡ هٰذَا الَّذِيۡ هُوَ جُنۡدٌ لَّكُمۡ يَنۡصُرُكُمۡ مِّنۡ دُوۡنِ الرَّحۡمٰنِؕ اِنِ الۡكٰفِرُوۡنَ اِلَّا فِيۡ غُرُوۡرٍۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Amman haazal lazee huwa jundul lakum yansurukum min doonir rahmaan; inilkaafiroona illaa fee ghuroor
ayahs.en: Or who is it that could be an army for you to aid you other than the Most Merciful? The disbelievers are not but in delusion.

ayahs.ar: اَمَّنۡ هٰذَا الَّذِيۡ يَرۡزُقُكُمۡ اِنۡ اَمۡسَكَ رِزۡقَهٗۚ بَلۡ لَّجُّوۡا فِيۡ عُتُوٍّ وَّنُفُوۡرٍ
ayahs.tl: Amman haazal lazee yarzuqukum in amsaka rizqah; bal lajjoo fee 'utuwwinw wa nufoor
ayahs.en: Or who is it that could provide for you if He withheld His provision? But they have persisted in insolence and aversion.

ayahs.ar: اَفَمَنۡ يَّمۡشِيۡ مُكِبًّا عَلٰي وَجۡهِهٖ٘ اَهۡدٰ٘ي اَمَّنۡ يَّمۡشِيۡ سَوِيًّا عَلٰي صِرَاطٍ مُّسۡتَقِيۡمٍ
ayahs.tl: Afamai yamshee mukibban 'alaa wajhihee ahdaaa ammany yamshee sawiyyan 'alaa siratim mustaqeem
ayahs.en: Then is one who walks fallen on his face better guided or one who walks erect on a straight path?

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ هُوَ الَّذِيۡ٘ اَنۡشَاَكُمۡ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ السَّمۡعَ وَالۡاَبۡصَارَ وَالۡاَفۡـِٕدَةَؕ قَلِيۡلًا مَّا تَشۡكُرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qul huwal lazee ansha akum wa ja'ala lakumus sam'a wal absaara wal af'idata qaleelam maa tashkuroon
ayahs.en: Say, "It is He who has produced you and made for you hearing and vision and hearts; little are you grateful."

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ هُوَ الَّذِيۡ ذَرَاَكُمۡ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ وَاِلَيۡهِ تُحۡشَرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qul huwal lazee zara akum fil ardi wa ilaihi tuhsharoon
ayahs.en: Say, "It is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered."

ayahs.ar: وَيَقُوۡلُوۡنَ مَتٰي هٰذَا الۡوَعۡدُ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ صٰدِقِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa yaqooloona mataa haazal wa'du in kuntum saadiqeen
ayahs.en: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ اِنَّمَا الۡعِلۡمُ عِنۡدَ اللّٰهِࣕ وَاِنَّمَا٘ اَنَا نَذِيۡرٌ مُّبِيۡنٌ
ayahs.tl: Qul innamal 'ilmu 'indallaahi wa innamaaa ana nazeerum mubeen
ayahs.en: Say, "The knowledge is only with Allah, and I am only a clear warner."

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّا رَاَوۡهُ زُلۡفَةً سِيۡٓـَٔتۡ وُجُوۡهُ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا وَقِيۡلَ هٰذَا الَّذِيۡ كُنۡتُمۡ بِهٖ تَدَّعُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Falaammaa ra-awhu zulfatan seee'at wujoohul lazeena kafaroo wa qeela haazal lazee kuntum bihee tadda'oon
ayahs.en: But when they see it approaching, the faces of those who disbelieve will be distressed, and it will be said, "This is that for which you used to call."

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ اَرَءَيۡتُمۡ اِنۡ اَهۡلَكَنِيَ اللّٰهُ وَمَنۡ مَّعِيَ اَوۡ رَحِمَنَاۙ فَمَنۡ يُّجِيۡرُ الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ مِنۡ عَذَابٍ اَلِيۡمٍ
ayahs.tl: Qul ara'aytum in ahlaka niyal laahu wa mam ma'iya aw rahimanaa famai-yujeerul kaafireena min 'azaabin aleem
ayahs.en: Say, [O Muhammad], "Have you considered: whether Allah should cause my death and those with me or have mercy upon us, who can protect the disbelievers from a painful punishment?"

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ هُوَ الرَّحۡمٰنُ اٰمَنَّا بِهٖ وَعَلَيۡهِ تَوَكَّلۡنَاۚ فَسَتَعۡلَمُوۡنَ مَنۡ هُوَ فِيۡ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِيۡنٍ
ayahs.tl: Qul huwar rahmaanu aamannaa bihee wa 'alaihi tawakkalnaa fasata'lamoona man huwa fee dalaalim mubeen
ayahs.en: Say, "He is the Most Merciful; we have believed in Him, and upon Him we have relied. And you will [come to] know who it is that is in clear error."

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ اَرَءَيۡتُمۡ اِنۡ اَصۡبَحَ مَآؤُكُمۡ غَوۡرًا فَمَنۡ يَّاۡتِيۡكُمۡ بِمَآءٍ مَّعِيۡنٍࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Qul ara'aytum in asbaha maaa'ukum ghawran famai yaateekum bimaaa'im ma'een
ayahs.en: Say, "Have you considered: if your water was to become sunken [into the earth], then who could bring you flowing water?"
